# Make space for a good story

Some days, the best way to read is to listen. A familiar voice turns a page of words into a little room to think.

There is no need to hurry. Follow the highlighted passage, pause when an idea stays with you, and return whenever you are ready.

Keep a bookmark for the lines you want to hear again. Your place will be waiting here.

# Find your own pace

A slower voice can make a difficult paragraph feel clearer. A faster one can carry you through a familiar chapter.

Choose the pace that suits this moment. The document stays on your computer, and the next page is always yours to explore.
